comments.author: participant5
comments.body:
Hi @reporter ;
We reviewed the issue and it was very hard to reproduce. 
We took the following actions to (hopefully) resolve this:
- Used a far newer (and more stable) Exasol container for the tests.
- Enabled an environment variable that reduces clutter in the logs by turning on rsyslogd. It also speeds up container startup.
- Re-enabled the Exasol test suite
 
I ran a couple 100 tests or so and it seems very stable.

Please have a look at this PR here and let us know what you think:
https://github.com/trinodb/trino/pull/27518

I had a look at both issues:
- I couldn't recreate the timeout issue, but we've added timeout guards for that reason.
- The second failure you reported seems to be caused by a network issue.

I created a new PR at https://github.com/trinodb/trino/pull/27941 adding timeout guards and a new waiting strategy for the container.
